feeds.title: Dad Blog UK
feeds.description: I am a married stay at home father with two young daughters. I write and make videos about parenting, fatherhood, lifestyle, food, travel and motoring etc. Gestation and Lactation; the only two things men can't do as parents.

feeds.title: Dad With A Pan Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Derek and I am a dad, food blogger, and fixer of broken toys. I love encouraging families to cook by sharing recipes, tips, and tricks that make cooking simple.

feeds.title: Diary of the Dad
feeds.description: Tom Briggs is a husband of one, dad of three and a multi-award-winning parent blogger and podcaster. The mission of this blog is to share his musings about parenthood.

feeds.title: SocialDad
feeds.description: Hi, I'm James and I'm a new Dad. I know nothing, apart from what I'm figuring out as I bumble along. My day job is in Social Media and Digital Marketing, so I'll be sprinkling in some updates, news, or opinion pieces around the industry. I'm also a keen photographer, camper, and car-lover.

feeds.title: Going Dad
feeds.description: I'm a health conscious stay-at-home dad looking for products that keep us fit, happy, and healthy. Follow along as I share our experience and discoveries with my daughter as a side-kick.

feeds.title: Daddy's Grounded
feeds.description: Daddy's Grounded was started by Joel Gratcyk as a way of remembering the personal experiences of fatherhood in all its details, with photos, video and written thought. Joel lives with his family in the western suburbs of Chicago.

feeds.title: St. Louis Dad
feeds.description: St. Louis Dad is a blog about fatherhood in St. Louis. Find out about all of the cool stuff dads can do in and around St. Louis. Also learn about various projects and activities dads can do with their kids.

feeds.title: Dad In Chief
feeds.description: Dad in Chief is a platform that focuses on 'Dadology', highlighting the challenges of fatherhood and masculinity. At a time where family relationships throughout the world are changing, it provides reflection elements and shares more than practical advice, all with lightness, humor, and authenticity. Built by a Millennial Dad, this blog is collaborative, inclusive, responsible and resolutely rooted in the 21st century.

feeds.title: Lunchbox Dad
feeds.description: At Lunchbox Dad find out about making bento school lunches, parenting tips, parenting products, parenting humor and have fun while doing it! Also find creative recipes, funny pictures, and thoughts on life in general. Author Beau Coffron is also seen on GMA, Steve Harvey Show, ABC, Yahoo, CNN, & More.

feeds.title: Casey Palmer
feeds.description: Casey Palmer is a Canadian Dad from Toronto, ON looking to raise his multiracial family of four in an urban environment that never quits. Between tech, food and travel, it's an awesome life in the making.

feeds.title: Millenni-Dad
feeds.description: The site is designed for millennial dads from every walk of life. Come be inspired and share in what it means to be a dad.

feeds.title: That Dad Blog
feeds.description: A dads blog about life with his six kids - one of which who is blessed with Down Syndrome and the ability of flight.

feeds.title: The Daily Working Dad
feeds.description: I'm just a normal dad with a regular job. I like to review items that I spend my hard earned money on. I don't take any 'big' purchase lightly, so I do extensive research before a big purchase, then come here to give you all the insight. Also, be sure to check out our family blogs where we share stories about our everyday life.

feeds.title: Modern Millennial Dad Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ryan. A thirty-something millennial dude with two amazing sons and an amazing wife! I created this site as a place for millennials and dads/parents who know the struggle can be real when it comes to parenting and leading a fulfilling lifestyle with kids.
